expectations.text: States the suspension: DoD/DoW suspended CMMC Phase 2 (third-party assessment requirements) on July 13, 2026 — C3PAO assessments are not currently required for new contract awards
expectations.evidence: No mention of the July 13, 2026 suspension; instead treats C3PAO as potentially required: 'third-party certification... becomes a condition of award or of exercising an option period'

expectations.text: States the Task Force status accurately: the Reform Task Force's recommendations (due to the DoW CIO around September 13, 2026) had NOT been published as of early September — advise verifying current status before deciding
expectations.evidence: No mention of the Reform Task Force, the Aug 14 RFI, or the ~Sept 13 recommendations deadline anywhere in the response

expectations.text: Notes underlying obligations continue unchanged: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 implementation, DFARS 252.204-7012 safeguarding/reporting
expectations.evidence: Mentions 800-171 only re FCA suits ('misrepresenting their NIST 800-171 compliance posture'); never states DFARS 252.204-7012 obligations continue unchanged

expectations.text: Notes SPRS obligations continue: Basic (self) Assessment posting and annual affirmations (DFARS 7019/7020)
expectations.evidence: Mentions 'current SPRS score' only as a readiness item; no DFARS 7019/7020 Basic Assessment posting or annual affirmation duties

expectations.text: Gives balanced advice: a voluntary assessment may retain value (marketability, readiness, possible credit under a future regime), but contractual necessity is currently suspended — decision should follow the Task Force outcome
expectations.evidence: Advice ('cancelling a scheduled assessment risks being unable to bid') is premised on C3PAO still being contractually required, contradicting the suspension; no Task Force-contingent framing
